description: Source code for a Bluetooth Gaming Audio Service (GMAP) server implementation, including role management, feature validation, and GATT service registration.

methods.name: read_gmap_role
methods.description: Reads the current GMAP role characteristic value.

methods.name: read_gmap_ugg_feat
methods.description: Reads the UGG feature characteristic value (if supported).

methods.name: read_gmap_ugt_feat
methods.description: Reads the UGT feature characteristic value (if supported).

methods.name: read_gmap_bgs_feat
methods.description: Reads the BGS feature characteristic value (if supported).

methods.name: read_gmap_bgr_feat
methods.description: Reads the BGR feature characteristic value (if supported).

methods.name: valid_gmap_role
methods.description: Validates if the specified role is supported and valid.

methods.name: valid_gmap_features
methods.description: Validates if the specified features are compatible with the role.

methods.name: update_service
methods.description: Updates the GATT service attributes based on the role.

methods.name: bt_gmap_register
methods.description: Registers the GMAP service with specified role and features.

methods.name: bt_gmap_set_role
methods.description: Updates the role and features of the GMAP service.
